verdict: GO for finite source-composition integration of the reviewed 36 hover borders
review_method: Viewed all 36 native before/after states in candidate-v1.
Viewed townHall, dwellingLvl5, resourceSilo, shipyard, dwellingUpLvl3 and castle enlarged four times.
Requested preservation of the attached T5 roof plane and far wooden pier.
Independently checked v1/v2 manifest hashes: only dwellingLvl5, dwellingUpLvl5 and shipyard borders changed.
Viewed those three exact v2 after.png images enlarged five times.
resolved_findings: Halls and guilds now exclude the broad backdrop triangles instead of outlining sky or snow hills.
The T5 base and upgrade retain their attached upper-right roof plane while excluding sunset scenery.
The shipyard includes the far wooden pier while excluding the surrounding water patch.
Fortification and T7 contours distinguish buildings from their large landscape platforms.
assessment: Consistent gold and dark support, with defensible architectural/site contours in this finite review.
limitations: Paintings retain their original backdrop pixels; this review covers only the border candidates.
Physical cave rims, animal-pen fences and built entrance steps are intentionally included.
Native hover occlusion, click selection and construction transitions remain unobserved by this reviewer.
No general artwork, gameplay, package or release acceptance is granted.
